```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5)
library(monopolyAtlas)
```

## 1. Per-sample monopoly metrics

Bulk 或 single-cell 表达矩阵 (genes x samples, 支持 dgCMatrix):

```{r}
set.seed(42)
m <- matrix(rgamma(2000 * 60, shape = 0.5, rate = 0.2), nrow = 2000)
rownames(m) <- c(paste0("Gene", 1:1990), paste0("RPL", 1:10))
colnames(m) <- paste0("Sample", 1:60)
tmi <- compute_tmi(m, k = 5)           # 管线口径: 排除 MT-/MTRNR/RPL/RPS
st <- monopoly_status(tmi)             # 95 分位判定
table(st)
sc <- score_monopoly(m)
head(sc$samples)
```

## 2. Query the atlas (74 monopoly genes)

```{r}
data("atlas_genes"); data("atlas_gene_cancer"); data("atlas_demand")
query_gene("WFDC2")
get_top_monopoly(5)
```

## 3. Manuscript visual language

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Fig1 STATE
plot_tmi_ridge(data.frame(sample = names(tmi), tmi5 = tmi,
                          cohort = rep(c("A", "B"), length.out = 60)))
# Fig2 CARRIER
plot_carrier_matrix(atlas_gene_cancer[atlas_gene_cancer$mono_freq > 0, ])
# Fig4 WHERE
plot_headroom(atlas_cancer[, c("cancer", "tmi5_median", "mono_rate")] |>
                setNames(c("cancer", "baseline", "mono_rate")))
# 单基因卡片
card <- plot_gene_card("WFDC2")
card$demand_plot; card$cancer_plot
```
